frame_bank.caveat: Offline aggregate only; excludes index/palettes/pivots and is not a playable container. Decoder dictionary is not its total heap requirement.

audio.lossy_caveat: Opus uses lossy resampling/encoding. Byte sizes are measurements, not evidence of equal sound quality or MIDP playback support.
